title: skillpack lock file (skillpack-lock.json)
description: What skillpack installed: the resolved commit of each pack and a hash of every rendered skill folder. Lives at the project root and is committed. Written by skillpack; don't edit it.

$schema.description: Schema URL. Its /v<N>/ folder sets the format version; a file without $schema is read as v1.

cli.description: Version of skillpack that wrote the file and its hashes.

packs.description: Installed packs, keyed by the same normalized source as in skillpack.json.

version.description: The resolved tag, or null when installed from a branch, a commit or a pack without tags.

branch.description: The branch the pack was resolved from, or null when it wasn't resolved from a branch. skillpack always writes it; lock files from before it existed still validate.

commit.description: Full commit SHA the skills were rendered from.

skills.description: Rendered skill folders, by path relative to the project root, with the content hash of each folder.
